name: Treppus-2 vibroknife
description: The Treppus-2 vibroknife was a popular type of vibro-knife produced by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.. A good example of a standard vibroblade, the Treppus-2 served as the basis for Merr-Sonn's M8 Combat Knife, which was used by the Galactic Republic's clone troopers during the Clone Wars.
